prompt:
AUDIO REFERENCE
{{AUDIO_PRISON_PA_COUNTING}}

AUDIO SOURCE AND SPATIAL TREATMENT

Use the uploaded Persian counting recording as the performance reference for the prison's overhead public-address system.

The counting comes from fixed institutional loudspeakers mounted high along the corridor outside the cell. Its source remains off-screen.

Preserve the supplied words, pronunciation, irregular rhythm, deliberate pauses and casually playful delivery.

Process the recording as an amplified announcement transmitted through an old institutional PA system:
a slightly narrow frequency range,
mild compression,
a restrained metallic speaker coloration,
and clearly audible reflections from the stone corridor.

Let a quieter, delayed reflection follow the direct amplified voice, suggesting sound traveling along the corridor and returning from distant walls. Keep the original words intelligible.

The announcement reaches everyone in the cell. Its impersonal, public quality makes the counting feel like an established prison routine.

Keep the sound anchored to the overhead corridor speakers across all camera angles. From inside the cell, hear it arriving through the barred opening with more reflected room sound. From the corridor, hear a clearer direct speaker signal.

The lead guard remains silent. He listens and moves his right index finger between prisoners in time with the counting accents. During the recorded pauses, he holds his finger on a prisoner and studies the reaction.

His pointing hand performs the selection; the loudspeaker supplies the counting.

TIMING

0–4 seconds:
Prison ambience and captive breathing.

4–17 seconds:
The uploaded counting performance plays through the PA system. Synchronize the guard's gestures and deliberate hesitations with its rhythm.

17–19 seconds:
The announcement has ended. Its final reverberation fades into the room while the guard holds his finger on the selected prisoner.

19–20 seconds:
The lock releases with one dry metallic click.
Cut immediately to black and silence.

SOUND MIX

Keep captive breathing, fabric movement and footsteps beneath the amplified counting. Let these small human sounds become more noticeable during its pauses.

The supplied recording is the only spoken content.
All visible characters remain silent.

NO MUSIC.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Palace Guards (GRP-005 V01); match it wherever Palace Guards appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Townsfolk Masked (GRP-009 V01); match it wherever Townsfolk Masked appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Rescued Survivors (GRP-010 V01); match it wherever Rescued Survivors appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Rescued Survivors (GRP-010 V02); match it wherever Rescued Survivors appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Townsfolk Masked (GRP-009 V10); match it wherever Townsfolk Masked appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Zahhak Prison (LOC-034 V01); match it wherever Zahhak Prison appears.
